name: Design System Phase 1 — Foundation Tokens & Theme
objective: Replace the existing theme/colors infrastructure under lib/ui/core/ with a fresh, vibrant & block-based design system. Create 8 new files (5 tokens + 3 theme builders) and update lib/main_app.dart to consume the new AppTheme. This phase establishes the design tokens (color, spacing, radius, motion, typography) and wires them into Material 3 light + dark ThemeData. Output of ui-ux-pro-max: indigo + orange palette, Fredoka (headings) + Nunito (body), 4-80px spacing scale, 4-24px radius scale.
exit_criteria: lib/ui/core/tokens/app_colors.dart exists with all 17+ color constants (primary, primaryLight, primaryDark, cta, ctaLight, ctaDark, success, warning, error, info, surfaceLight, surfaceDark, surfaceVariantLight, surfaceVariantDark, backgroundLight, backgroundDark, borderLight, borderDark, textPrimaryLight, textPrimaryDark, textSecondaryLight, textSecondaryDark, textDisabledLight, textDisabledDark)

lib/ui/core/tokens/app_spacing.dart exists with Spacing class exposing the 4-80px scale (xxs through xxxl) and 5 common combination tokens (pagePaddingMobile, pagePaddingTablet, pagePaddingDesktop, cardPadding, sectionGap, listItemVerticalPadding)

lib/ui/core/tokens/app_radius.dart exists with Radii class exposing radius values (xs through full) + pre-built BorderRadius instances + 8 component-specific presets (button, card, input, fab, chip, avatar, modal, bottomSheet)
lib/ui/core/tokens/app_duration.dart exists with AppDurations class (fast, normal, slow, slower, instant) + AppCurves class (standard, entering, exiting, bounce)

lib/ui/core/tokens/app_typography.dart exists with AppTypography class exposing all 15 Material text styles via GoogleFonts.fredoka (display* + headline*) and GoogleFonts.nunito (title* + body* + label*)

lib/ui/core/theme/app_color_schemes.dart exists with lightColorScheme and darkColorScheme (Material 3 ColorScheme with all 17+ roles: primary, onPrimary, primaryContainer, onPrimaryContainer, secondary, onSecondary, secondaryContainer, onSecondaryContainer, tertiary, onTertiary, tertiaryContainer, onTertiaryContainer, error, onError, errorContainer, onErrorContainer, surface, onSurface, surfaceContainerHighest, onSurfaceVariant, outline, outlineVariant, shadow, scrim, inverseSurface, onInverseSurface, inversePrimary)
lib/ui/core/theme/app_text_themes.dart exists with lightTextTheme and darkTextTheme applying onSurface colors via .apply(bodyColor:, displayColor:)

lib/ui/core/theme/app_theme.dart exists with AppTheme.light() and AppTheme.dark() factories returning ThemeData with useMaterial3: true, colorScheme, textTheme, scaffoldBackgroundColor, and basic component themes (filledButton, outlinedButton, textButton, card, appBar, inputDecoration)
lib/main_app.dart updated: import path switched to lib/ui/core/theme/app_theme.dart; BlocoNaRuaTheme.lightTheme/darkTheme replaced with AppTheme.light()/AppTheme.dark()
All 8 new Dart files pass `flutter analyze` with 0 errors
All constants in tokens files are `static const` (compile-time) and follow project naming (PascalCase classes, camelCase constants, snake_case files)
All string literals use double quotes
No emojis anywhere in the deliverables
Zero Colors.X.Y references inside theme/ files — all colors sourced from app_colors.dart (src-prefixed or by name)
lib/main_app.dart still compiles without breaking the auth gate (BlocProvider<AuthCubit> + MaterialApp.router remain intact)
